summary: Results-driven IT Analyst with 7.9 years of experience specializing in cloud automation, CI/CD pipeline development, and infrastructure management across AWS and Azure. Proven expertise in Python scripting, Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab, and Ansible to deliver scalable on-premise and cloud-native automation solutions that drive operational excellence. Hands-on experience administering Linux and Solaris environments, deploying containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes, and optimizing cloud costs through intelligent automation.

bullets: Designed and maintained fully automated CI/CD pipelines for code deployment using GitLab, Jenkins, Ansible, Docker, and Kubernetes, accelerating release cycles and ensuring operational excellence.
Provisioned and managed AWS cloud infrastructure including EC2, S3, VPC, ECS, and ECR using Terraform and Python (Boto3), establishing scalable and repeatable infrastructure-as-code standards.

Authored reusable Terraform modules for Azure resource provisioning—including VMs, storage accounts, virtual networks, application gateways, and load balancers—to enforce cloud governance and standardization.

Developed Python-based CLI tools and Lambda functions to automate cloud-native workflows, including SQS/S3 event integration with SNS, log management via Auto Scaling Groups, and vulnerability remediation across thousands of servers.
Automated Azure snapshot lifecycle management, certificate expiry alerting, and resource tagging governance, delivering combined annual cloud cost savings exceeding $15,000.
Built Ansible-driven Linux patching automation and autonomous host inventory systems for 1,500+ servers, reducing manual effort and improving security compliance.

Administered 3,000+ Unix servers (Linux, Solaris, AIX), providing L2/L3 troubleshooting for CPU, memory, disk, and service incidents while maintaining SLA compliance and executing disaster recovery protocols.

Implemented Service Improvement Plans leveraging Git for version control and GitLab for CI/CD, automating vulnerability segregation, patch reporting, and backup processes to enhance platform reliability.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deploy NewRelic monitoring across 100+ Linux servers and automate incident response for critical outages, improving mean time to detection and resolution.
Conducted POCs for containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, supporting cloud-native automation strategies and modernizing legacy infrastructure management.
